title: Annex III: Quality of the Trade-Based Money-Laundering Control Landscape
organizations: United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime
publisher: United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime

rating_scale.direction: Higher values indicate stronger control effectiveness

strategic_cooperation_integrity: National commitment, policy and coordination on TBML
Domestic cooperation and information-sharing for TBML
Control of corruption in the jurisdiction
trade_facilitators: Knowledge of trade facilitators on TBML
Controls and oversight over trade facilitators
Record-keeping, monitoring and cooperation of trade facilitators
reporting_intermediaries: Customer due diligence, monitoring and record-keeping
customs: Fit-and-proper checks and internal corruption controls
fius: Fit-and-proper checks and internal corruption controls
Knowledge and skills of FIU staff

assessment_principles: Assess design, implementation, reach and outcomes.
Do not treat formal existence of a law or policy as proof of effectiveness.
Use evidence from administrative records, audits, case outcomes, interviews and external assessments.
Maintain separate mainland and FTZ ratings where required.
Document participants, evidence, caveats, deficiencies, rationale and follow-up actions.
ftz_reference: OECD Code of Conduct for Clean Free Trade Zones under the Recommendation of the Council on Countering Illicit Trade.
evidence_domains: Customs, tax, shipping and trade data
FTZ registers, digital inventory and data-exchange logs
